summary: Swiftwater rescue of a firefighter who had spent the night clinging to a tree in a flood-stage canyon; he was swept a half-mile downriver through rocks and debris, escaped on a floating log, and was found unconscious at a house, then extracted using swiftwater techniques, heavy machinery, and a highline
notes: Search initiated Thursday 2013-09-12; firefighter found and rescued a day later, 2013-09-13. RMR's first call of Sept 12 while assessing routes to cut-off mountain areas.
